notes.title: The seque is out! Vetrix Worlds is the Ultimate VR Puzzle Adventure!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992860/Vetrix_Worlds/

Team up with a friend in Cooperative mode and tackle puzzles together, or fight against them in the Versus mode. You can also enjoy stress-free gameplay in various single-player Arcade modes, or unlock content in the Campaign.

Adapt your strategy to conquer unique challenges presented by special shapes like the elusive "Ephemeral" and the resilient "Resistant."

Gain an edge over your opponents with powerful new power-ups such as the game-changing "Trash Can" and the strategic "Holder."

Climb the global leaderboards and unlock achievements to showcase your puzzle-solving prowess to the world.

Prepare your VR headsets, because Tetriminos are waiting to be stacked in Vetrix Worlds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/710d36ed0b6fe013675d7c24b14ce4202542283b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Vetrix Worlds' Demo is here! 🥳
notes.content:
The Demo for Vetrix Worlds is out! 🥳

In this Demo, you'll experience one Arcade Mode with its two modifiers (Classic and Special) as well as one Campaign World with 5 stages.
The rest of the features, such as Multiplayer Versus and Co-op, the three other Arcade Modes, and the other Campaign Worlds will be available in the full game.

Enjoy! 💖

Get the demo on Vetrix Worlds' store page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992860/Vetrix_Worlds]here[/url].

notes.title: Vetrix Worlds is coming! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/3c8aa45b1c3f3457530c827faea0b900121c0fdf.png[/img]

[h1]Get ready for the next chapter in the Vetrix series![/h1]

Vagabond is proud to announce Vetrix Worlds, the latest puzzle game in the beloved franchise.

As in the original game, players must match shapes in a three-dimensional space, but with some exciting new twists.

Vetrix Worlds features improved graphics and new gameplay mechanics, including a new campaign mode that will take you around the world, two multiplayer modes (versus and co-op), new block types, new power-ups, a new arcade mode, and more...

Vetrix Worlds will soon be available in Early Access and we can't wait to get your feedback!

Are you ready to take on the challenge of Vetrix Worlds? Get ready to put your puzzle-solving skills to the test!

[b]Wishlist now! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992860/Vetrix_Worlds/

notes.title: New Game Mode for Vetrix!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're adding new stuff to the game! :)

- [b]A new "Free Mode"![/b] That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new 8-bit music track! 
- [b]More languages![/b] French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
- [b]Two new color palettes![/b] See the image below to discover which palettes won our Discord poll.
- Some quality of life changes.

This new update is based on your feedback and we hope you'll like it.
Thank you so much for supporting the game! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/4a8477bd155e3c2cdeedc4ddc534da141341cd7c.png[/img]

notes.title: It's time for a surprise update! 😎
notes.content:
Hello, my lovely little pixels! 😁

With Vetrix reaching new markets, we're adding new stuff to the game!

That allows you to play without any time constraints, and has its own new dope 8-bit music track!

[b]- More languages![/b]
French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese (and Korean shortly after).

[b]- And of course, two new color palettes![/b]
That you can vote for by joining our Discord at the link below!
https://discord.gg/VtzJPaA

notes.title: Vetrix is out!
notes.content:
For [b]YOU[/b], lovers of classic puzzlers and VR addicts!

[b]Vetrix [/b]is a VR puzzler inspired by [b]Tetris for the Game Boy[/b], in which you enter a retro-themed universe with [b]striking colors[/b] to demonstrate dexterity, organization, and good skills in the geometry of space as well as proprioception.

Beware, this ain't your Grandma's Tetris! ^^

The game is [b]available now[/b], go get it! ;)
